name: Sahel insurgency
summary: JNIM insurgency persists in Mali; no blockade or fall of a capital reported
state: JNIM attacks on army positions in Mali continued through the autumn, including a deadly camp attack claimed in September (Washington Post). The Africa Center describes a long trajectory of worsening security. Searches on 5 Nov found no current blockade or fall of a capital or major city, and no spread of mass-casualty attacks to coastal states.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.

sources.title: Washington Post — JNIM claims deadly Mali army camp attack
Africa Center — Attacks in Mali mark long trajectory of worsening security

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.

rubric.alert: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.
